description: A stationary, weathered green-and-orange diesel locomotive numbered 713, seen from a low front-left three-quarter view. Its long hood, cab, vents, handrails, steps, bogies and coupler lead into attached rail cars on gravel tracks. A traffic cone, yard containers, hills, trees, blue sky and a parked white pickup establish depth.
cameraIntent: Begin at the photographed low front-left view. Orbit roughly 19 degrees toward the locomotive nose while translating slightly along the track and lifting modestly, preserving the full engine and revealing handrail, hood, bogie and rail-car parallax.
invariants: The locomotive and all rail cars remain stationary.
Preserve the green/orange 713 engine, long hood, rails, bogies, coupler and track alignment.
No driver, passenger or other person appears.

normalization.operation: EXIF orientation, centered uniform cover crop to exact aspect ratio; no stretching or generative editing
